:_mod-docs-content-type: PROCEDURE

[id="caching-a-model-for-faster-loading_{context}"]
= Cache a model on local node disks

[role="_abstract"]
You can cache a model on local node storage by creating a `LocalModelCache` resource with a reference to a `LocalModelNodeGroup`.
After the model is cached, any `InferenceService` or `LLMInferenceService` with a matching `storageUri` automatically loads the model from the local cache instead of downloading it from remote storage.
Local disk caching supports cross-namespace sharing, which means that inference services in any namespace can use the cached model.

.Prerequisites

* You have cluster administrator privileges for your {openshift-platform} cluster.
* You have enabled model cache on the cluster.
For more information, see xref:enabling-model-cache_{context}[Enable model cache].
* You have configured at least one model cache node group.
For more information, see xref:configuring-model-cache-node-groups_{context}[Configure model cache node groups].
* If the model is stored in a private registry, you have configured download credentials.
For more information, see xref:configuring-model-download-credentials_{context}[Configure model download credentials].
* You know the model URI, for example `hf://meta-llama/Llama-3-70B`, and the estimated size of the model.

.Procedure

. Create a `LocalModelCache` resource:
+
[source,yaml]
----
apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1alpha1
kind: LocalModelCache
metadata:
  name: <model_cache_name> <1>
spec:
  sourceModelUri: "<model_uri>" <2>
  modelSize: "<model_size>" <3>
  nodeGroups:
    - "<node_group_name>" <4>
----
+
--
Where:

`<model_cache_name>`:: Specifies a unique name for this cached model, such as `llama3-70b`.
`<model_uri>`:: Specifies the URI of the model in remote storage, such as `hf://meta-llama/Llama-3-70B`.
This URI must match the `storageUri` used in your `InferenceService` or `LLMInferenceService` resources.
`<model_size>`:: Specifies the estimated size of the model, such as `140Gi`.
The model size must not exceed the `storageLimit` defined in the node group.
`<node_group_name>`:: Specifies the name of the `LocalModelNodeGroup` where the model should be cached.
--
+
Optionally, if you configured credentials by using method 2 (service account), add the `serviceAccountName` field:
+
[source,yaml]
----
spec:
  serviceAccountName: "<service_account_name>"
----

. Apply the resource:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc apply -f <model_cache_file>.yaml
----
+
The controller creates download jobs on each node in the specified node group.
Each job downloads the model from the `sourceModelUri` to local storage.

. Monitor the download job progress:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get jobs -n <job_namespace>
----
+
Replace `<job_namespace>` with the namespace configured for download jobs in the `inferenceservice-config` ConfigMap.
+
[NOTE]
====
Cached models are immutable.
You cannot update a cached model in place.
To cache a new version of a model, delete the existing `LocalModelCache` resource, and then create a new resource with the updated `sourceModelUri`.
====

.Verification

. Verify that the `LocalModelCache` status shows the model is downloaded on all target nodes:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get localmodelcache <model_cache_name> -o jsonpath='{.status.nodeStatus}'
----
+
The output shows `NodeDownloaded` for each target node.
+
The following table describes the possible `NodeStatus` values:
+
[cols="1,2", options="header"]
|===
|Status
|Description

|`NodeNotReady`
|The node is not ready to download the model.

|`NodeDownloadPending`
|The download job has been created but has not started.

|`NodeDownloading`
|The model is being downloaded to the node.

|`NodeDownloaded`
|The model has been downloaded and is available for use.

|`NodeDownloadError`
|The download job failed. Check the job logs for details.
|===

. Verify the `LocalModelNode` resources show the model as cached:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get localmodelnodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}: {.status.modelStatus}{"\n"}{end}'
----
+
The output shows `ModelDownloaded` for the cached model on each target node.
